# Python delivery

1. Read `AGENTS.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, and the relevant product and architecture documents.
2. Create a plan in `docs/plans/` before implementation when the request introduces new behavior.
3. Implement the smallest complete change under `src/atwood/`.
4. Add focused tests as a feature introduces a test suite.
5. Run the relevant `uv` commands and report their results.
